positive_snippets:
The Grand Orion is a luxurious and well-maintained hotel, ideal for a comfortable stay.
Rooms are spacious, tastefully furnished, and equipped with all modern amenities.
Staff is courteous, attentive, and ensures a smooth and pleasant experience.
The hotel ambiance is elegant, with beautifully landscaped surroundings and serene spaces to relax.
Dining options are excellent, with a variety of tasty dishes served fresh.
Overall, a perfect choice for business trips, family vacations, or a weekend getaway.

The warmth of the welcome immediately created a positive impression and carried through the entire stay. The rooms were spacious, clean, and thoughtfully furnished, providing a relaxing environment after a busy day. The staff were consistently attentive and courteous, always ready to assist with a genuine smile. Its central location makes exploring the city easy, while the peaceful interiors ensure restful nights. A perfect choice for travelers looking for both convenience and comfort.

The only glitch in my stay was my exchange with the night manager - as I walked into the hotel well past 11,30pm with my 9 yr old son.

He asked for my ID, and then my son's. Usually IDs of minors aren't asked. So I questioned why was his ID needed. To my question, the manager said "What is the problem in giving the ID?" A better response would have been - "Our management has implemented this rule.  We need to have IDs for every guest including kids." The man was arrogant.

The housekeeping guys and the ones in the restaurant however, were pretty good.

The hotel in itself is good. It is a clean area, your car gets a parking space within the premises.

Ensure you book the breakfast while you book the room. Because at 350/- the breakfast spread might look a tad too expensive if you want to just walk into the restaurant in the morning.

The room was comfortable, the bathroom had all the needed products including dental kits.  Much appreciated.
negative_snippets:
Thoroughly a three-star hotel.

The room was clean enough and had a decent view. Didn't have any food there, so can't comment on that aspect.

One thing that was strange was that a cleaner rang my doorbell close to checkout not only to greet me, but also to offer to help me pack (!) and carry my bags downstairs. After I declined the help, he said that he would wait for me outside my room (which he indeed did). A bit creepy.
